method: Separate read-through after the first passing fixture run, checking shared-memory races, barrier placement, bounds, integer widths, edge cases and unintended changes to the scoring contract.
checked_without_finding: Shared term_block/term_weight are written before the first barrier and only read after it.

Decode tiles alternate two warp-total buffers; a buffer is rewritten only after the next tile's barrier, when all readers are done. The same argument covers the two candidate-slot buffers in selection.
Loop bounds that contain barriers depend only on shared values identical for every thread.
Each thread reads and retires only the score slots it owns (slot % threads), after the barrier that ends accumulation.
Positions are in range for any index that passes rbp_load plus the round-trip check; prefix sums stay below the range size.
Zero-score documents stay eligible; slots past the last document in a partial range are never scanned.
Ties use original numeric IDs read from the device ID map, never internal positions.
Query wall time covers sparse query construction, query upload, both kernels, top-k download and event synchronisation; index load/upload, the gate, verification and file writes are outside.

findings.issue: The uint32 overflow gate assumed one posting per (term, document). A repeated pair could exceed weight_sum*255.
findings.impact: None on the project data (no repeats), but the gate was not a true bound for arbitrary GSP input.
findings.fix: rbp_max_multiplicity scans the index once at start-up; the gate multiplies the bound by it and the value is reported to the runtime gate.

findings.issue: ranges*k was computed in uint32 and could wrap for very small ranges on very large corpora.
findings.impact: Not reachable at the registered settings.

findings.issue: A range size needing more shared memory than the device allows failed with a generic CUDA error.

checks_after_fixes: tests/check_range_bitpack.py on RTX 4070 Laptop (CUDA 13.3, sm_89): 36 index configurations, 180 scorer runs, 3640 query checks, 8 expected rejections, all passing.
validation_limits: The overflow gate cannot be triggered under cap-32 weights and the 128-term limit, so its rejection path is covered by inspection only.
Fixtures use at most 8,292 documents; multi-range behaviour at scale is covered by the real-data comparisons.
Queries with more than 128 terms are rejected, not scored; the longest calibration query has 95 terms.
k is limited to 0..128 as in the shared GPU top-k.
Local development used CUDA 13.3 on sm_89; the CIMS build uses CUDA 12.6 and is checked separately.
